readme_excerpt: Welcome To Athens, Gophers! Welcome to the Athens project! Athens is an open source, enterprise ready implementation of the Go Module proxy for the Go Modules download API. See our documentation site https://docs.gomods.io for more details on the project. We are looking for people who would like to become core maintainers of this project.
